about: Which specimen draws each property and enumerated value of cytoscapejs-vocabulary.json (at most a few named each), or why none can; written by cytoscapejs.mjs.

events.notDrawn: interaction only: whether the element answers mouse and touch events; draws nothing

text-events.notDrawn: interaction only: whether a label answers events; draws nothing

box-selection.notDrawn: interaction only: how a box selection picks elements; draws nothing

transition-property.notDrawn: animation only: which properties animate when a style changes; a still drawing has none

transition-timing-function.notDrawn: animation only: the easing of a style transition

box-select-labels.notDrawn: interaction only: whether a box selection counts labels; draws nothing

position.notDrawn: parsed and never read: Cytoscape.js 3.34.3's renderer and bounds code never look the property up (no pstyle('position') call); it draws nothing

selection-box-color.notDrawn: core, interaction only: the drag box of a box selection, drawn only while dragging

selection-box-opacity.notDrawn: core, interaction only (box selection drag box)

selection-box-border-color.notDrawn: core, interaction only (box selection drag box)

selection-box-border-width.notDrawn: core, interaction only (box selection drag box)

active-bg-color.notDrawn: core, interaction only: the touch circle drawn while a tap is held on the background

outside-texture-bg-color.notDrawn: core, interaction only: the background drawn while a textured viewport pans
